title: TurnRiverLab v16.2 GTO algorithm convergence benchmark

methodology.metric: Median wall-clock milliseconds from fresh solver setup through exact convergence checks and final summary
methodology.precision: Float64 WebAssembly; all game trees include their configured exact chance outcomes
methodology.stopping: TARGET only after the independent exact Nash exploitability check reaches the case target; LIMIT is not treated as convergence
methodology.cautions: One device and small benchmark trees. Performance varies by pot, board, ranges, action sizes, target, browser and thermal limits. QRE is not ranked because it solves a different objective.
